Yes—Inference Auctions is the closest match: it proposes an auction for LLM inference when demand exceeds compute, where users bid for faster service and an autobidding agent adjusts bids under a budget constraint. It aims to allocate priority efficiently while preserving latency benefits, which fits an LLM API priority bidding system [1].

If you meant a broader bidding system for ads or auctions rather than LLM API priority, several other papers are related but not the same: some study auto-bidding in ad auctions [2, 5, 8], and others focus on ad auction mechanisms inside LLM chatbots [3, 4].
